activities.name: Dragondola (Naeba ↔ Kagura)
activities.notes: Japan's longest gondola (5,481 m), linking Naeba to Kagura over a 25-minute ride. Included with the Mt. Naeba lift pass in winter; runs in summer for sightseeing too.

activities.name: Ponshukan Yuzawa Sake Museum
activities.notes: Inside the Echigo-Yuzawa Station building: 500 yen buys five tokens for a self-serve tasting of 100+ Niigata sake. Also has a sake-bath and snack stalls.

activities.name: Yamano-yu Onsen
activities.notes: Classic free-flowing public bath in Yuzawa town, one of the three public soto-yu attached to Yuzawa's historic onsen. Tattoos generally accepted.

activities.name: Komako-no-Yu
activities.notes: Named after the protagonist of Kawabata's 'Snow Country'. Small village-run bath with simple indoor and outdoor pools.

activities.name: Yuzawa Town Museum (Yukiguni-kan)
activities.notes: Small museum on Kawabata Yasunari's 'Snow Country', Echigo-Yuzawa's literary claim to fame. Reproductions of his writing room and period photos.

activities.name: Yuzawa Kogen Ropeway
activities.notes: Cable car from town to a small ski/sightseeing area on Mt. Takamatsu. 7-minute walk from Echigo-Yuzawa Station; popular for non-skier panoramic views.
